label: Final

coverage.text: Fall 2026 Final (Thu 12/17, 3–6pm). This option assumes the whole course.

scope.note: Problems from any topic in the course are included. That classification is this site’s, not a staff recommendation.

noPicks: Course staff haven’t named practice questions here yet, so nothing is marked recommended.

timed.intro: Each exam draws problems from the whole course at random.

exams.note: The solution PDF is scanned. Diagram questions are described in text; the struck A* question is omitted.
